name: Akhmat Foundation (Regional Public Fund named after Akhmat Kadyrov)
note: Charitable foundation named after the first Chechen president; front-shirt sponsor and listed partner of RFK Akhmat. US Treasury designated it in December 2020 as owned or controlled by Chechen head Ramzan Kadyrov; the UK sanctioned it in September 2025 over 're-education' programmes for deported Ukrainian children. Its president is Aymani Kadyrova, Ramzan Kadyrov's mother.
